cues.text: Hello?
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: Yes, I’d like to speak with Janet Evans, please.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Speaking
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: Hi Ms. Evans, this is Jim Rodriguez calling from Farrelly Mutual about your recent homeowner’s insurance inquiry
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Yes, hi. Thanks for returning my call.
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: My pleasure. I understand you are potentially interested in insurance for a bungalow located a bit out of town. Could you give me the address?
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Sure, it’s 49 Greenway Court. Greenway is one word.
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: Thank you. Alright, and would you prefer to be contacted via email or phone?
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Either one is fine - maybe try emailing me first and as an alternative I can give you my phone number.
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: Great - and what is your email address?
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: pk2@cat.com.
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: Hm, did you say “cat”, as in the animal?
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Yes. It is the acronym for the construction company I work for - I’m sure you’ve seen them around.
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: Yes, I have. And could you give me your primary phone number, and the best time to reach you?
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Sure - the number is (020) 4251-9443. I am generally unable to answer my phone at work, but anytime after 5.30 p.m is fine.
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: I will make a note of that here. Now I’m going to ask you a little bit about the property itself so we can make an accurate estimate of the cost of insuring your home.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Could you tell me the size of your house?
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Um, well, I don’t have the exact measurements, but I’m pretty sure it’s right around 80 square metres. Should I measure it and call you back later?
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: No, that’s completely alright. I’ll write 80 square metres for now to get the estimate and then an agent will come get the exact measurements later on if you decide to purchase our insurance.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Okay, great.
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: And what material is your house made of? For example, wood, brick, stucco,...
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: It’s mainly brick.
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: Great - that will give you a lower rate than most other materials since it is so strong.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Wonderful!
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: And do you have any sort of home security, Ms.Evans?
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Um, we don’t have a fence or anything yet, but we have an alarm system that we use regularly.
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: Good.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Now I’ll go through a number of things we offer coverage for, and I’d like you to tell me which items you want your policy to cover.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Okay.
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: We’ll start with the building itself first - would you like us to cover incidental damage to the structure to your house?
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Absolutely.
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: Splendid. And the contents inside your house - we usually cover all items with an appraised value above £200.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Would you like us to cover theft and damage beyond natural wear-and-tear?
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: I will let you know that the second option here will come with a considerable increase in your rates.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: I think I’d just like the contents of the house to be covered against theft then.
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: Alright - and would you like any other insurance - fire, flood, etc?
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Yes - definitely want flood coverage. It rains a lot here, and the drainage system in the area is not the greatest.
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: Okay. I am calculating your quotation now. It will just take a second. (Two seconds pause) It looks like your annual insurance rate will be £148.30.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Thanks, that seems somewhat reasonable. I would like to take some time to think about it. How long does it take to begin receiving coverage after signing up?
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: It depends on the time of year - it can take anywhere from two to six weeks. I would say if you sign up by July 1st, you could start your coverage by August 1st.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: I see. Okay, thanks for your help. Should I call you back at this number when I have made my decision?
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: Yes, please. And so that we can look up your account faster, I’ll give you a reference number that you should provide when calling. Ready?
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Yep!
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: It’s TR278Q.
cues.speaker: Agent

cues.text: Got it. Thanks!
cues.speaker: Janet

cues.text: Thank you, and have a nice day!
cues.speaker: Agent
